description: Ottawa F-65 Sand Data from Ana Maria Parra Bastidas is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Ekin Gultepe, University of Canterbury (canterbury.ac.nz). The dataset contains detailed characterization data for Ottawa F-65 index properties and element test results. It provides an experimental dataset used to describe the physical and mechanical behavior of this widely studied granular soil. This dataset is intended for use in research on soil liquefaction, constitutive modeling, cyclic soil response, and laboratory-based soil characterization. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 55 top-level files (XLSX, TXT, PDF, CSV, PNG). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2mw2r. Keywords: earthquake engineering, databases, Ottawa, F-65, sand, one-dimensional compression. Published 2016-05-17. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
